snippets.doc: The <NuxtErrorBoundary> component handles client-side errors happening in its default slot, using Vue's onErrorCaptured hook.
snippets.label: NuxtErrorBoundary

snippets.doc: The <NuxtWelcome> component greets users in new projects made from the starter template. It includes links to the Nuxt documentation, source code, and social media accounts.
snippets.label: NuxtWelcome

snippets.doc: Nuxt provides <NuxtLink> component to handle any kind of links within your application.
snippets.label: NuxtLink

snippets.doc: <NuxtLayout /> can be used to override default layout on app.vue, error.vue or even page components found in the /pages directory.
snippets.label: NuxtLayout

snippets.doc: The <NuxtLoadingIndicator> component displays a progress bar on page navigation.
snippets.label: NuxtLoadingIndicator

snippets.doc: <NuxtPage> is a built-in component that comes with Nuxt. NuxtPage is required to display top-level or nested pages located in the pages/ directory.
snippets.label: NuxtPage

snippets.doc: The <ClientOnly> component renders its slot only in client-side. To import a component only on the client, register the component in a client-side only plugin.
snippets.label: ClientOnly
